title: plectranthus chevalieri
intro: Plectranthus chevalieri, commonly known as Mountain Balm, is a plant species in the family Lamiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, relieving anxiety and stress, and supporting respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Plectranthus chevalieri are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, that have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Additionally, the plant has been traditionally used to treat fever, digestive issues, and as a natural remedy for skin conditions due to its antiseptic properties.
